what_they_do: Faction sells AI agents to industrial distributors and manufacturers (PVF, electrical, HVAC, packaging, safety) that read incoming customer emails, PDFs, and phone calls and turn them directly into quotes, purchase orders, and invoices inside the company's existing ERP. It replaces the manual work of staff retyping scattered, messy quote requests into the ERP and manually chasing vendor confirmations, invoice matching, and collections calls. The product plugs into systems like SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Epicor Prophet 21/Eclipse, and Infor without requiring the distributor to switch ERPs.
vertical: Industrial distribution and manufacturing software (PVF, electrical, HVAC, packaging, safety)
theme_fit_rationale: Faction's agents read and write across quoting, pricing, procurement, and AP/AR inside a distributor's ERP, matching the cross-functional multi-system workflow-agent pattern directly (quote-to-cash, procurement, AR/AP are named use cases). The entry wedge is parsing messy unstructured inputs (emails, PDFs, calls) into structured records, which also fits the unstructured-data-as-a-wedge theme.
workflow_artifacts: ERP records (SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Epicor Prophet 21/Eclipse, Infor)
